text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the day of the GII Kyoto 
Daishoten has arrived—an important race 
that will foretell the autumn GI campaign.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The jewel of the Satono Group, Satono 
Diamond, electrifies the audience with her 
elegant greeting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, though nearly overwhelmed by 
the crowd's cheers, Cheval Grand rallied 
herself by recalling the summer training 
camp where she pushed hard alongside her 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To run the best race possible in the Japan 
Cup—first, she must learn from today's 
race.
